response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with ~15 years of software experience, current Staff-level tenure, and directly relevant exposure to MCP servers and agentic-workflow tooling. However, his AI-specific experience appears limited to roughly the past year, falling well short of the required 8+ years building production AI solutions, and the resume shows no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, evaluation pipelines, or leading customer-facing technical discovery — all core to this forward-deployed GenAI role.
strengths: Hands-on experience with MCP code generators and AI-agent infrastructure in current Staff role
Deep full-stack engineering background in TypeScript/Node.js with cloud and DevOps exposure (AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes)
Proven mentorship and knowledge-sharing track record (workshops, courses, open-source projects)
concerns: Far short of the required 8+ years building production AI-driven solutions (~1 year of AI work)
No demonstrated RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent framework experience
Little evidence of customer-facing technical discovery or forward-deployed/consulting delivery experience

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG/vector DB and evaluation expertise
